# VICTA — Czech Full-Service Digital Agency

> VICTA je česká digitální agentura zaměřená na střední a větší podniky v ČR a SR. Pod jednou střechou stavíme weby a e-shopy na míru, vyvíjíme AI chatboty a automatizace, řídíme PPC + SEO + AEO + sociální sítě a navrhujeme komplexní transformace digitálního provozu. Pracujeme jako partner, ne jako dodavatel — začínáme placeným auditem nebo bezplatnou konzultací.

## Services

VICTA delivers 18 distinct services across four practice areas:

### IT & Development
- **Weby na míru** — Bespoke websites built from scratch, designed for your brand and growth.
- **E-shopy na míru** — Custom e-commerce systems that integrate with your operations and scale.
- **Integrace** — System integrations that connect your data, tools, and workflows.
- **Custom solution development** — Software built precisely to your business logic.

### AI & Data
- **AI chatboti** — Conversational AI that understands your customers and your business.
- **AI automatizace procesů** — Eliminating manual work where it adds no value.
- **AI konzultace + audit + strategie** — Finding where AI brings the most leverage for you.
- **Datová platforma + integrace** — Unified, clean, decision-ready data.
- **MLOps / Provoz AI systémů** — Reliable AI in production: monitoring, retraining, escalation.

### Marketing & Content
- **SEO** — Long-term organic visibility.
- **AEO** — Optimization for AI search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews).
- **PPC kampaně** — Paid campaigns with measurable revenue impact.
- **Social media management** — Strategy, content, community — long-term brand work.
- **Tvorba kreativ** — Visual content that converts.
- **E-commerce management** — Full e-shop operations from catalog to retention.
- **Marketingová strategie** — Strategic alignment of marketing with business goals.

### Cross-team
- **Komplexní transformace byznysu** — Marketing + IT + AI + data, integrated.
- **Dlouhodobá správa & růst klienta** — Long-term partnership, not one-off projects.

## Solutions

Five packaged AI solutions:

- **Znalostní asistent** — Custom internal knowledge assistant for your team.
- **Autonomní agenti** — Multi-step task automation with AI agents.
- **AI podpora zákazníků** — AI-augmented customer support.
- **Datové dashboardy** — Decision-grade real-time dashboards.
- **AI infrastruktura** — Foundational AI systems built for production scale.

## Industries served

VICTA has deep operational understanding of:

- E-commerce
- Manufacturing & logistics (Výroba & logistika)
- Professional services (Profesionální služby)
- Finance
- Healthcare (Zdravotnictví)
- Customer-support-heavy operations (Zákaznická podpora)

## How we work

We engage clients via two paths:

1. **Paid audit** (Tier 1: Komplexní podnikový audit, Tier 2: Doménový audit, Tier 3: Strategická session) — a structured analysis with PDF report, Excalidraw diagrams, Figma artifacts, and an in-person review session. Pricing is consultative; ranges are 4 000–90 000 Kč / €160–€3 600 depending on tier and scope. Payment by invoice and bank transfer (no online card payment).
2. **Free 30-minute scoping call** — a no-commitment introduction for visitors with a specific service question.

Both paths are bookable directly via Cal.com on https://victaagency.com/cs/spoluprace.
